critical_code_review_comments: theme-context.tsx correctly defaults to dark palette when no ThemeProvider is present — grep confirms admin/_layout.tsx and all admin/*.tsx import `colors` (dark) from @/src/theme with no ThemeProvider wrapper, keeping the admin surface untouched.

lightColors palette in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts mirrors the dark palette's semantic keys (surface, onSurface, brand, border, etc.) plus shellBlur, so palette-aware refactors in shared components (ui.tsx, MobileShell, DesktopShell, PhoneField, PhotoGrid, DatePickerField, NotificationBell) can swap themes without additional code branches.
Reveal.tsx scroll-reveal works smoothly on landing and marketing pages; sections stay visible after entering viewport (no repeat flicker on further scroll).
Client OTP dev toast auto-fills the otp-code-input (verified programmatic value read '955333'), which matches the documented OTP_DEV_MODE UX and makes end-to-end automation reliable.

Seeded admin admin@lumiere.studio still has profile_complete=false (confirmed via /api/auth/admin/login curl response) — same behaviour flagged in iteration_4. Not a bug, just requires onboarding to reach /admin; the onboarding + dashboard are visibly DARK as expected.
